action.cobblemonnml.type_mechanic.bug.ac: Use a targeted or self move; the eligible stat group follows targeting mode.
action.cobblemonnml.type_mechanic.bug.de: Adapts through the highest eligible IV+EV trained stat. Targeted moves use offensive/speed branches; self moves use HP/defensive branches.
action.cobblemonnml.type_mechanic.dark.a: Land a qualifying interaction while the Dark mechanic is active.
action.cobblemonnml.type_mechanic.dark.d: Qualifying interactions progressively obscure the opposing Pokémon's HUD and awareness.
action.cobblemonnml.type_mechanic.dragon: Use qualifying actions while the Dragon mechanic is active.
Builds toward Uproar. Active Uproar uses its Dragon combat state and is followed by Dragon-specific Sleep.
action.cobblemonnml.type_mechanic.electr: Use any move; damaging projectile moves trigger Plasma chains.
Creates roaming Plasma Balls. Damaging projectile moves can chain through nearby balls and create secondary damage areas.
Creates one movement-mimicking illusion. Targeted moves copy the target; self moves copy the user.
action.cobblemonnml.type_mechanic.fighti: Raises a brief guard that blocks incoming melee and projectile damage.
action.cobblemonnml.type_mechanic.fire.a: Use any committed move or take damage.
action.cobblemonnml.type_mechanic.fire.d: Builds Fire Pressure. At full Pressure, Inferno turns the gauge into ammo, raises the highest offense and defense stats, and adds explosions to actions.
action.cobblemonnml.type_mechanic.flying: Maintain valid line of sight and use ranged or melee actions while the Flying mechanic is active.
Builds Momentum while maintaining line of sight. Ranged actions gain projectile/channel benefits and melee actions gain Flying propulsion behavior.
Targeted actions can apply the current Ghost curse and subeffect mechanics.
Plants Seeds that bloom into Flowers. Any Grass mechanic identity can collect a Flower for healing over time and a random +1 stat.
action.cobblemonnml.type_mechanic.ground: Use a damaging targeted move or a self move.
Creates Shockwaves that build Sink while Pokémon remain inside. Sink slows movement, disables Swap at 60%, and KOs at 100%.
action.cobblemonnml.type_mechanic.ice.de: Creates a Chilling Aura that continuously slows Pokémon movement and projectile motion, up to 99%.
action.cobblemonnml.type_mechanic.normal: A non-Normal effective move type appears at least twice in the current moveset.
Adapts to repeated non-Normal move types and gains those ACTION type mechanics.
action.cobblemonnml.type_mechanic.poison: Use a projectile, melee, or self move.
Leaves Sludge based on move delivery. Pokémon standing in Sludge lose a random stat stage each second, and Poison is converted to Toxic.
action.cobblemonnml.type_mechanic.psychi: Use a targeted move or a self-channel move.
Targeted moves channel and resolve directly on the target without a travelling projectile or melee dash. Self-channel moves allow movement while channeling.
action.cobblemonnml.type_mechanic.rock.d: Creates constructs that reflect projectiles and block melee attacks. Target constructs persist for 9 seconds; self constructs last through the action/channel.
A self move activates Magnet Rise or Weighted from effective weight. While active, the state modifies any targeted damaging move.
Creates floating Aqua Bubbles that seek enemies, trap and immobilize on contact, and break when the trapped Pokémon takes damaging move damage.
action.cobblemonnml.warning.recall_block: You can't recall at the moment.
action.cobblemonnml.warning.use_swap: Use Swap Out during an action battle.
death.attack.life_transfer: %1$s gave their life for their Pokemon
death.attack.life_transfer.player: %1$s gave their life for their Pokemon
